evidence_summary: CRLF1 is a cytokine-receptor-like complex component that acts with CLCF1 and CNTFR-associated receptor complexes; the public CRLF1-to-LIFR row does not establish LIFR as a standalone receptor.
limitations: Retain intact CRLF1/CLCF1/CNTFR receptor-complex topology; do not materialize LIFR as an isolated CRLF1 receptor or transfer CNTF-family complex evidence to unrelated receptor forms.
